scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hello, I recently applied for a housing loan and wanted to check on the status of my application. Could you tell me if it has been approved, denied, or is still pending? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved. You were approved for a conventional first lien loan.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know. Could you also provide me with the interest rate and the total costs associated with this loan? Additionally, are there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: The interest rate on your loan is 6.625%. The total costs associated with the loan are $4,971.48. This loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage, and it does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. Could you also tell me if my loan has been transferred or sold to another institution? Additionally, what is my debt-to-income ratio and how does it impact my application?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has been sold to Fannie Mae. Your debt-to-income ratio is between 20% and 30%. This ratio represents the percentage of your monthly income that goes toward paying debts. A lower ratio generally indicates a lower risk to lenders.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for providing that information. I appreciate your help and clarity throughout this process.

<Very Satisfied> The agent was very helpful and provided all the information I needed in a clear and professional manner.
